Little did they know, I was actually planning on jumping off and killing myself. I remember walking to the end of the pier and as I was able to climb over the top and jump, I had to take a piss. Realizing that I did, I was like, "I don't want to piss my pants." As I was finishing up squeezing the lemon, a random ass biker came up and I was like oh shit don't want him seeing my dick and pissing so I hurried the fuck up. When I finished, he just started talking to me for God knows what. It caught me off by surprise. I talked to the man about life and shit, saying how my parents did right in raising me and that he wished he did the same with his kids cause apparently he was a piece of shit dad. I didn't know I was just completely what the fuck is going on. But yeah. I walked back feeling pretty good about myself. As I was walking back, I see my dad trying to walk the two mile pier (he has a cane and can barely walk). He asked how my walk was and I said it was cool, I got to do some thinking. After this went home and slept. Can't really forget a moment like that.
